text_block_list.text: When I head to the library to do some research—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My my, working so hard today as well, dear~.
Have you found any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, once it gets into specialized medical texts, it's pretty hard to understand the content, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: As for the cause of motion sickness, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To put it simply, it apparently occurs when a mismatch arises between the inner ear and visual information... so it says.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A mismatch... Is there a way to cure that, dear?
I would hate for you to push yourself too hard, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It seems getting accustomed to it is the clearest method after all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But... ugh, having to endure that nausea constantly until I get used to it sounds so awful.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah... T-Trainer!
Um, what is this good idea?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-This place is...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: A park, isn't it? Fufu, the children over there are playing so energetically, dear~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, what on earth are we doing here?
If it's vehicles, wouldn't an amusement park be better...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Swings, you say?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see~.
That certainly qualifies as a 'swaying vehicle', doesn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! I-I see...!
With this, I might be able to manage without overdoing it...!
Even swaying like on a swing should serve well as a means to get acclimated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice, Trainer!
I'll try it right away!
choice_data_list: Let's have as much fun with it as we can!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break, dear~.
Are you feeling sick at all?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm okay! I felt a slight twinge of motion sickness, but I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whenever it feels risky, I can just stop it with my own feet right away!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I think I can keep this up for a long time. Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Isn't that wonderful, dear~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still, swings...
Nowadays I'm the one pushing the children from behind, but when I was little, I was the one being pushed, dear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
When someone gave me a big push, I felt like
I could touch the sky... Fufu, it made my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! In that case, why don't we try it together this time?
You can sit down, Creek-san,
and I'll stand and pump the swing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We won't reach the sky, but as the saying goes,
"Look up from the water's surface to find the blue"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll be much more fun that way,
and I probably won't even think about motion sickness!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! That does sound lovely~.
But if you start feeling unwell at all,
please tell me right away, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to support you firmly, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes!

After taking a short break,
the two of them shared a single swing,
showing innocent, childlike smiles.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're right, I'll do that!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't remember ever getting motion sickness from swings
when I was little... Ehehe, I'm gonna pump with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...I got carried away and overdid it.
U-Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, are you alright~?
Shall I go buy you something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You were trying so hard and looked so adorable, Chiyono-chan,
that I was too late to stop you... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No. It's truly "putting a wooden doll on lookout"...
I brought this on myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In any case, let's rest.
Once we get back to the dorms, you can rest your head on my lap~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come on, lean on me... Ah, or would you like me to carry you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that won't be necessary...
Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, to both of you...
Next time, I'll take it much, much easieeerrr...

Dizzy and stumbling, she leaned on Super Creek's
shoulder as they headed back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll do that.
Ah, if you'd like, why don't you two join me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's sway leisurely
while having a nice chat~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The weather is so lovely...
It feels so nice, at this rate even the motion sickness...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It would be wonderful if you overcome it soon
and get to go on drives with Maruzen-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? H-How did you know about that...!?
I only said I get motion sickness easily!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you get flustered so adorably.
It's written all over your face~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-chan is such a wonderfuuuul
horse girl, so I completely understand why you admire her~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! T-That's right!
Maruzen-san is truly amazing, she's—

With Maruzensky brought up,
Sakura Chiyono O began passionately talking about her.

Thanks to that,
she didn't even have time to feel sick—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... I don't feel sick at all.
Amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in talking that I wasn't
paying attention to the swaying at all...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This must be what they call
"Conquering negativity in a daydream"!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Good girl, you worked so hard~.
I'm so glad you didn't get sick.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ganbaru!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe worrying about getting sick is what makes it worse.
If I just keep my focus elsewhere as much as possible...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I master this trick, I might be able to handle cars too!
I can see a glimmer of hope!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

Though not a fundamental cure,
Sakura Chiyono O found a small ray of hope towards fulfilling her drive.
